definitions.full: H7752. shot שׁוֺט noun masculine Isa 28:15 scourge, whip (Late Hebrew id. , so Arabic , () mix, stir about and beat ; Ethiopic Aramaic שׁוֺטֶא , ; from foregoing? compare German streifen ; or onomatopoetic, compare swish, switch ?); — ׳שׁ absolute 10:26 +, construct Job 5:21 ; plural שׁוֺטִים 1Kin 12:11 +; — 1 scourge , for chastisement, 1Kin 12:11 , 14 2Chr 10:11-12 , (all with verb יִסַּר ); figurative of national scourge (wielded by ׳י ) Isa 10:26 ; 28:15 (Qr; > Kt שׁיט ), 28:18 (both ׳שׁ שׁוֺטֵף , see שׁטף ), calamity Job 9:23 ; lash of (accusing) tongue 5:21 (read ׳מִשּׁ as ᵐ5 ). 2 whip , for horse, שׁ ׳קוֺל Nahum 3:2 i.e. crack of whip , ׳שׁ לַסּוּם Prov 26:3 (|| כְּסִילִים לְגֵו שֵׁבֶט ).
